triples.tail_surface: rise in temperature / formation of steam in the pump
triples.evidence_text: The pump must not run against a closed valve as this will cause a rise in temperature / formation of steam in the pump which may cause damage to the pump.

triples.head_surface: rise in temperature / formation of steam in the pump
triples.evidence_text: rise in temperature / formation of steam in the pump which may cause damage to the pump

triples.tail_surface: connection of a bypass or drain to the outlet pipe
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 连接旁通管或排放管至出口管路
triples.evidence_text: If there is any special design of the pump running against a closed valve, ensure a minimum liquid flow through the pump by connection of a bypass or drain to the outlet pipe.

triples.head_surface: Operation outside 70 to 120 % of BEP flow
triples.head_canonical_zh: 在70%至120%最佳效率点流量范围外运行
triples.tail_surface: reduce the pump life (incl. shaft seal and pump bearings) significantly
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 显著缩短泵寿命（含轴封和轴承）
triples.evidence_text: Operation outside 70 to 120 % of BEP flow reduce the pump life (incl. shaft seal and pump bearings) significantly.

triples.tail_surface: shorter lifetimes of e.g. bearings and/or shaft seals in pumps (and bearings in motors)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 泵轴承或轴封及电机轴承寿命缩短
triples.evidence_text: vibration levels above 7 mm/s are damaging – i.e. this will result in shorter lifetimes of e.g. bearings and/or shaft seals in pumps (and bearings in motors) than normally expected
This agrees with the recommendations in the international standard ISO10816-3.

triples.head_surface: High vibration levels at pump / motor top
triples.tail_surface: external excited vibrations combined with the relative high Centre of Gravity compared with the size of the pump baseplate and/or the foundation stiffness below
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 外部激励振动叠加重心过高或基座刚度不足
triples.evidence_text: Often external excited vibrations combined with the relative high Centre of Gravity compared with the size of the pump baseplate and/or the foundation stiffness below result in too high vibration levels in pump and motor top.

triples.head_surface: pump is running with much higher flow than it is designed for
triples.evidence_text: pump is running with much higher flow than it is designed for – this can cause so high turbulence levels in pump and piping system that excessive vibrations occur

triples.tail_surface: reinforcing the foundation stiffness below the base plate of the pump
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 加强泵基板下方基础刚度
triples.evidence_text: Changing the structure can minimize the vibration level significantly - either by reinforcing the foundation stiffness below the base plate of the pump

triples.tail_surface: adding lateral supports at pump top / motor mounting flange level
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在泵顶部或电机安装法兰处增加侧向支撑
triples.evidence_text: Changing the structure can minimize the vibration level significantly - ... or by adding lateral supports at pump top / motor mounting flange level

triples.head_surface: lateral supports are transferring hull vibrations
triples.head_canonical_zh: 侧向支撑传递船体振动
triples.tail_surface: flexible element can then be added
triples.evidence_text: In cases where the lateral supports are transferring hull vibrations (e.g. from main engine in ship) to the support connection points on pump or motor then a flexible element can then be added
